name: app-pale-blue-testimonial-quotes-with-portrait-tiles
title: Pale Blue Testimonial Quotes with Portraits
whatItIs: A tall pale slide with two large quotes where phrases shift between black and grey, each paired with a rounded portrait tile, name and role, and a hand-held phone in a glowing tile between them.
whatItMeans: Big quotes with rounded portraits feel personal and trustworthy, and the tone shifts guide reading.
techniques: Oversized quote marks in the accent blue
Black-to-grey phrase shifts inside a quote
Portrait tile overlapping the quote text edge
Name, age and job as a caption under each face
A product tile breaking up the two quotes

vocabulary.definition: A large statement from a user with an attributed portrait.
Changing text between dark and light greys to guide reading.
A rounded square photo used as an avatar.
